items.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns of "unsustainable silliness" in compute buildout
items.summary: Sam Altman warns of "unsustainable silliness" in the global AI data center buildout. Too many Neocloud providers are announcing massive capacity without the customers to back it up. He also admits that falling computing costs could turn today's billion-dollar projects into bad bets, even for OpenAI. The article OpenAI CEO Sam Altman warns of "unsustainable silliness" in compute buildout appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Sam Altman 警告稱，全球人工智慧資料中心建設中存在「不可持續的愚蠢行為」。太多新雲端服務供應商宣佈提供龐大的容量，卻沒有相對應的客戶支援。他也承認，計算成本的下降可能會使如今耗資數十億美元的專案變成糟糕的投資，即使對 OpenAI 而言也是如此。本文《OpenAI 執行長 Sam Altman 警告計算建設中存在「不可持續的愚蠢行為」》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: Meta closes in on the top with Muse Spark 1.3, and undercuts rivals on price
items.summary: Meta has released Muse Spark 1.3, its fourth model in the series in five months. According to Artificial Analysis, the model gains the most on agentic benchmarks but still trails Claude Fable 5.1 and other top models. The strongest argument is price. At $0.55 per task, Muse Spark undercuts every comparably scored rival. The article Meta closes in on the top with Muse Spark 1.3, and undercuts rivals on price appeared first on The Decoder .
items.summary_zh: Meta 在五個月內發布了該系列的第四款模型 Muse Spark 1.3。據 Artificial Analysis 稱，該模型在智能體基準測試中進步最大，但仍落後於 Claude Fable 5.1 和其他頂級模型。其最有力的競爭優勢在於價格。 Muse Spark 的單次任務價格為 0.55 美元，低於所有同等評分的競爭對手。文章《Meta 憑藉 Muse Spark 1.3 縮小與榜首的差距，並以更低的價格擊敗競爭對手》最初發表於 The Decoder 網站。

items.title: Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon
items.summary: Perplexity has open sourced Lily, the local inference engine behind Hybrid Compute in Perplexity Computer. Built in Rust with custom Metal kernels for one model on one chip family, it averages 1.23x MLX-LM's prefill throughput and 1.35x its decode throughput on a 40-core, 128 GB M5 Max. The post Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Perplexity 已開源 Lily，它是 Perplexity 計算機混合計算背後的本地推理引擎。 Lily 使用 Rust 語言編寫，並針對單一晶片系列上的單一型號定製了 Metal 核心。在 40 核心、128 GB 記憶體的 M5 Max 處理器上，其預填吞吐量平均是 MLX-LM 的 1.23 倍，解碼吞吐量平均是 MLX-LM 的 1.35 倍。這篇文章《Perplexity 開源 Lily：基於 蘋果 晶片的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 Rust + Metal 推理引擎》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Qwen Developers Open-Sources zg (zvec-grep): A Local-First Search Layer Unifying ripgrep, BM25, and Vector Search
items.summary: We look at zg (zvec-grep), the local-first search layer that Qwen Developers just open-sourced under Apache 2.0. We explain how it puts ripgrep, BM25, and vector search behind a single interface, so an agent can move from a plain-language description to an exact line span without switching tools. We cover the deliberately small MCP surface, the on-device embedding catalog, and the authorization gate that stands between local content and remote models. The post Qwen Developers Open-Sources zg (zvec-grep): A Local-First Search Layer Unifying ripgrep, BM25, and Vector Search appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 讓我們來看看 zg (zvec-grep)，這是 Qwen 開發人員剛剛根據 Apache 2.0 協定開源的本機優先搜尋層。我們將解釋它如何將 ripgrep、BM25 和向量搜尋整合到一個統一的介面中，從而使代理無需切換工具即可從純文字描述精確到行跨度。我們將介紹其特意設計的精簡的 MCP 介面、設備端嵌入目錄以及位於本地內容和遠端模型之間的授權機制。本文《Qwen 開發人員開源 zg (zvec-grep)：統一 ripgrep、BM25 和向量搜尋的本地優先搜尋層》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: US Department of Justice backs fair use for AI training in landmark copyright case
items.summary: In the class-action lawsuit involving The New York Times, the US Department of Justice argues that training AI models on copyrighted text qualifies as fair use. The filing directly contradicts a report from the US Copyright Office. Its director was fired by the Trump administration shortly after the report was published. The article US Department of Justice backs fair use for AI training in landmark copyright case appeared first on The Decoder .

items.title: Meet Switchyard: A Rust Proxy and Library That Routes and Translates LLM Traffic Across OpenAI and Anthropic APIs
items.summary: NVIDIA has released Switchyard, an Apache-2.0 Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic. It decodes requests into provider-neutral types, routes them with passthrough, random, LLM-classifier, or stage-router algorithms, and translates responses back into the client's format, so Claude Code or Codex CLI can run against vLLM, NIM, or Ollama unchanged. The project is pre-alpha and not for production. The post Meet Switchyard: A Rust Proxy and Library That Routes and Translates LLM Traffic Across OpenAI and Anthropic APIs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: 輝達 發布了 Switchyard，這是一個用於 LLM 流量的 Apache 2.0 Rust 代理程式庫。它將請求解碼為與提供者無關的類型，並使用直通、隨機、LLM 分類器或階段路由演算法進行路由，並將回應轉換回客戶端格式，以便 Claude Code 或 Codex CLI 可以直接在 vLLM、NIM 或 Ollama 上運行。該項目目前處於 pre-alpha 階段，不適用於生產環境。這篇文章《認識 Switchyard：一個用於在 OpenAI 和 Anthropic API 之間路由和轉換 LLM 流量的 Rust 代理程式庫》最初發佈於 MarkTechPost。

items.title: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: One Core Model, Two Access Envelopes
items.summary: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber on September 2, 2026. Both variants run on the same foundational intelligence, split by safety mitigations rather than model size. Gemini 3.8 Flash is generally available at $0.75 and $3.75 per 1M tokens, introductory through December 31, 2026. Flash Cyber reaches 47.2% pass@1 on CWE-Bench and is restricted to vetted defenders through the Fairwind Program. This article covers the benchmarks, the token-for-accuracy tradeoff, and what deploying either one actually requires. The post Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: One Core Model, Two Access Envelopes appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Google 於 2026 年 9 月 2 日發布了 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber。這兩個版本基於相同的底層智能，差異在於安全緩解措施而非模型大小。 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的官方售價為每百萬代幣 0.75 美元和 3.75 美元，優惠期至 2026 年 12 月 31 日。 Flash Cyber 在 CWE-Bench 測試中達到了 47.2% 的 pass@1 成功率，並且僅限通過 Fairwind Program 認證的防禦者使用。本文將介紹基準測試、代幣與準確率之間的權衡，以及部署這兩個版本所需的具體要求。文章「Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber：一個核心模型，兩種訪問範圍」最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon
items_ai.summary: Perplexity has open sourced Lily, the local inference engine behind Hybrid Compute in Perplexity Computer. Built in Rust with custom Metal kernels for one model on one chip family, it averages 1.23x MLX-LM's prefill throughput and 1.35x its decode throughput on a 40-core, 128 GB M5 Max. The post Perplexity Open Sources Lily: A Rust + Metal Inference Engine for Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on Apple Silicon appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Perplexity 已開源 Lily，它是 Perplexity 計算機混合計算背後的本地推理引擎。 Lily 使用 Rust 語言編寫，並針對單一晶片系列上的單一型號定製了 Metal 核心。在 40 核心、128 GB 記憶體的 M5 Max 處理器上，其預填吞吐量平均是 MLX-LM 的 1.23 倍，解碼吞吐量平均是 MLX-LM 的 1.35 倍。這篇文章《Perplexity 開源 Lily：基於 蘋果 晶片的 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B 的 Rust + Metal 推理引擎》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Qwen Developers Open-Sources zg (zvec-grep): A Local-First Search Layer Unifying ripgrep, BM25, and Vector Search
items_ai.summary: We look at zg (zvec-grep), the local-first search layer that Qwen Developers just open-sourced under Apache 2.0. We explain how it puts ripgrep, BM25, and vector search behind a single interface, so an agent can move from a plain-language description to an exact line span without switching tools. We cover the deliberately small MCP surface, the on-device embedding catalog, and the authorization gate that stands between local content and remote models. The post Qwen Developers Open-Sources zg (zvec-grep): A Local-First Search Layer Unifying ripgrep, BM25, and Vector Search appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: 讓我們來看看 zg (zvec-grep)，這是 Qwen 開發人員剛剛根據 Apache 2.0 協定開源的本機優先搜尋層。我們將解釋它如何將 ripgrep、BM25 和向量搜尋整合到一個統一的介面中，從而使代理無需切換工具即可從純文字描述精確到行跨度。我們將介紹其特意設計的精簡的 MCP 介面、設備端嵌入目錄以及位於本地內容和遠端模型之間的授權機制。本文《Qwen 開發人員開源 zg (zvec-grep)：統一 ripgrep、BM25 和向量搜尋的本地優先搜尋層》最初發表於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Meet Switchyard: A Rust Proxy and Library That Routes and Translates LLM Traffic Across OpenAI and Anthropic APIs
items_ai.summary: NVIDIA has released Switchyard, an Apache-2.0 Rust proxy and library for LLM traffic. It decodes requests into provider-neutral types, routes them with passthrough, random, LLM-classifier, or stage-router algorithms, and translates responses back into the client's format, so Claude Code or Codex CLI can run against vLLM, NIM, or Ollama unchanged. The project is pre-alpha and not for production. The post Meet Switchyard: A Rust Proxy and Library That Routes and Translates LLM Traffic Across OpenAI and Anthropic APIs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: 輝達 發布了 Switchyard，這是一個用於 LLM 流量的 Apache 2.0 Rust 代理程式庫。它將請求解碼為與提供者無關的類型，並使用直通、隨機、LLM 分類器或階段路由演算法進行路由，並將回應轉換回客戶端格式，以便 Claude Code 或 Codex CLI 可以直接在 vLLM、NIM 或 Ollama 上運行。該項目目前處於 pre-alpha 階段，不適用於生產環境。這篇文章《認識 Switchyard：一個用於在 OpenAI 和 Anthropic API 之間路由和轉換 LLM 流量的 Rust 代理程式庫》最初發佈於 MarkTechPost。

items_ai.title: Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: One Core Model, Two Access Envelopes
items_ai.summary: Google released Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber on September 2, 2026. Both variants run on the same foundational intelligence, split by safety mitigations rather than model size. Gemini 3.8 Flash is generally available at $0.75 and $3.75 per 1M tokens, introductory through December 31, 2026. Flash Cyber reaches 47.2% pass@1 on CWE-Bench and is restricted to vetted defenders through the Fairwind Program. This article covers the benchmarks, the token-for-accuracy tradeoff, and what deploying either one actually requires. The post Google DeepMind Releases Gemini 3.8 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber: One Core Model, Two Access Envelopes appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items_ai.summary_zh: Google 於 2026 年 9 月 2 日發布了 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber。這兩個版本基於相同的底層智能，差異在於安全緩解措施而非模型大小。 Gemini 3.8 Flash 的官方售價為每百萬代幣 0.75 美元和 3.75 美元，優惠期至 2026 年 12 月 31 日。 Flash Cyber 在 CWE-Bench 測試中達到了 47.2% 的 pass@1 成功率，並且僅限通過 Fairwind Program 認證的防禦者使用。本文將介紹基準測試、代幣與準確率之間的權衡，以及部署這兩個版本所需的具體要求。文章「Google DeepMind 發布 Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash Cyber：一個核心模型，兩種訪問範圍」最初發表於 MarkTechPost。
